mechanism: Clopidogrel increases bleeding risk while zoledronic acid may cause osteonecrosis of the jaw and atypical fractures; combined use requires careful monitoring in patients with bone metastases or osteoporosis undergoing antiplatelet therapy.
action: Monitor for bleeding complications and ensure adequate dental hygiene; consider dental evaluation before zoledronic acid initiation in patients on clopidogrel; assess bleeding risk versus thromboembolic risk for indication-specific benefit.
